title: Ahaz’s Wicked Reign

questions.question: How old was Ahaz when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:1 (ESV): "Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What evil did Ahaz commit?
options: Made metal images for the Baals and burned his sons as an offering
questions.correctAnswer: Made metal images for the Baals and burned his sons as an offering
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:2-3 (ESV): "...he made metal images for the Baals... and he burned his sons as an offering..."

questions.question: Into whose hand did God give Ahaz?
options: The king of Syria and the king of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The king of Syria and the king of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:5 (ESV): "Therefore the LORD his God gave him into the hand of the king of Syria... He was also given into the hand of the king of Israel..."

questions.question: How many men of Judah did Pekah execute in one day?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:6 (ESV): "For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed 120,000 in Judah in one day..."

questions.question: Who was Zichri, and what did he do?
options: A mighty man of Ephraim; he killed the king's son
questions.correctAnswer: A mighty man of Ephraim; he killed the king's son
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:7 (ESV): "And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed the king's son Maaseiah..."

questions.question: How many captives did the Israelites take?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:8 (ESV): "The men of Israel took captive 200,000 of their relatives..."

questions.question: Who met the returning army of Israel in Samaria?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:9 (ESV): "But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded..."

questions.question: What did Oded tell them to do?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:11 (ESV): "Now hear me, and send back the captives..."

questions.question: Who clothed and fed the captives?
options: Certain chiefs of the men of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: Certain chiefs of the men of Ephraim
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:12-15 (ESV): "Then certain chiefs of the men of Ephraim... took the captives, and with the spoil they clothed all..."

questions.question: Where did they return the captives?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:15 (ESV): "...and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees..."

questions.question: To whom did Ahaz send for help?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:16 (ESV): "At that time King Ahaz sent to the king of Assyria for help."

questions.question: Did the king of Assyria help him?
options: He came to him, but oppressed him instead of strengthening him
questions.correctAnswer: He came to him, but oppressed him instead of strengthening him
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:20 (ESV): "So Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came against him and afflicted him instead of strengthening him."

questions.question: What did Ahaz do in his distress?
options: He became yet more faithless to the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: He became yet more faithless to the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:22 (ESV): "In the time of his distress he became yet more faithless to the LORD..."

questions.question: To which gods did Ahaz sacrifice?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:23 (ESV): "For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus that had defeated him..."

questions.question: What did Ahaz do to the house of God?
options: Gathered the vessels and cut them in pieces, and shut up the doors
questions.correctAnswer: Gathered the vessels and cut them in pieces, and shut up the doors
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 28:24 (ESV): "Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and he shut up the doors of the house of the LORD..."

key_verse_text: In the time of his distress he became yet more faithless to the LORD—this same King Ahaz.
